AEROTECHSS.COM — REDESIGN DRAFT, REV 1

Static mockups built to the token system in REDESIGN-BRIEF.md: navy #16203A / #343C5C, orange #FB722E at ~5% of pixels, Archivo + Inter + IBM Plex Mono, 1200px container, one 8px radius.

All photography is their own client project work, downsampled. All copy is drafted from the existing site's real content — no lorem, no invented facts.
Mobile is a different hierarchy, not the desktop stacked: credential strip goes 2-up, services drop to three cards plus a link, and the phone number becomes a tap target of its own.

TWO THINGS DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK

1. Fuel-burn / emissions savings per turn on the TaxiBot case — marked PLACEHOLDER rather than estimated.

2. Client quotes. There are currently zero testimonials anywhere on the site. Two or three would do more for conversion than anything else in this draft.

The wordmark is a type lockup standing in for a proper vector logo — the current logo.png is a low-resolution raster and needs redrawing.
